remoteDesktopCapture.title: Share Desktop Screen
remoteDesktopCapture.message: The mobile app is requesting to view this computer's screen.
remoteDesktopCapture.detail: Sharing applies to this connection by default. After you choose a source, the paired phone can view it live. Enable remote input separately; availability depends on system permission and the shared content. Remembering this phone allows the current capture to be reused. If the system ends sharing or the app restarts, you may need to choose a source again. Turn off automatic sharing in Settings. Avoid sharing windows with sensitive information.
